summary.name: We-Connect
summary.one_liner: We-Connect is a LinkedIn automation and lead generation platform that monitors buying-intent signals on LinkedIn and runs AI-assisted outreach campaigns.
use_cases: Find prospects engaging with your LinkedIn posts or profile
Automate LinkedIn connection requests and follow-up messages
Source and nurture passive candidates for recruiting
Schedule and remix LinkedIn posts to stay visible
Sync LinkedIn leads into a CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot
Run combined LinkedIn and email outreach sequences
summary.what_it_does: We-Connect monitors LinkedIn intent signals such as people engaging with your posts, visiting your profile, or interacting with competitors, and can add them to a pipeline automatically. Its Lead Engine lets users build outbound workflows that branch, score, and route contacts based on behavior. AI agent nodes score leads from 0 to 100 and read sentiment from post engagement, and an AI Assist feature drafts connection requests and follow-ups personalized from profiles. It also supports combined LinkedIn and email sequences with A/B testing, a post scheduler with a remix tool for trending content, and syncs with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Make, Zapier, and Slack. The page also mentions email enrichment, charged only when an email is found.
notable: Watchlist monitors LinkedIn engagement and profile visits as buying-intent signals (marked Beta)
AI agent nodes score leads 0-100 and route contacts automatically
Combined LinkedIn and email workflows with A/B testing
Integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Make, Zapier and Slack
caveats: Listing tags the tool as paid; page advertises a free 14-day trial with no credit card required, and post-trial pricing is not stated on the page
Post Remix is listed as an add-on
Page states it is not affiliated with LinkedIn; LinkedIn automation may carry account-risk considerations not discussed on the page
